headline: The Era of End-to-End Autonomy: Transitioning from Rule-Based Driving to Large Driving Models
reason: This paper highlights a significant architectural shift in autonomous driving, moving from traditional modular, rule-based systems to unified, learning-based end-to-end (E2E) driving systems, integrating perception, prediction, planning, and control within single frameworks. This represents a fundamental change in AI architecture for self-driving cars, with implications for improved performance in complex scenarios and scalability, as evidenced by developments like Tesla's Full Self-Driving (FSD) V12-V14.
